notes: Tuition left out: the supplied pages give no tuition amount for this programme or for a non-EU applicant with a household abroad (no fixed non-EU fee, no Morocco-linked country group, no single income-based lowest/highest pair tied to this programme). Several rounds exist for this applicant: registration opens 07 April 2026 with deadline 01 July 2026 (see evidence), the pre-immatricolazione window is 07 April 2026 – 14 luglio 2026, and the Universitaly visa pre-enrolment deadline is 31 luglio 2026; only the first round (registration) is reported as applicationDeadline. The nationality-based country list (Morocco) was not found in the supplied pages. The B2 Italian requirement is listed for 'Corsi di Laurea ... erogati in lingua italiana', while this programme is taught in English; it is kept as a manual check. Art. 10 also refers to a selection ('vincitori della selezione') and the assessment is compulsory.
